description: Bundlebee binary groupId.

name: bundlebee.check-update.artifactId
description: Bundlebee binary artifactId.

name: bundlebee.check-update.classifier
description: Bundlebee binary classifier.

name: bundlebee.check-update.type
description: Bundlebee binary type (extension) in maven coordinates.

description: Manifest to add the aveolus inside.

description: Alveolus name.

name: bundlebee.add-alveolus.image
description: Deployment image.

name: bundlebee.add-alveolus.type
description: Alveolus/template type. `web` will create a `ConfigMap`, `Deployment` and `Service`.

name: bundlebee.add-alveolus.overwrite
description: If `false`, generated files already existing will be skipped.

name: bundlebee.apply.alveolus
description: Alveolus name to deploy. When set to `auto`, it will deploy all manifests found in the classpath. If you set manifest option, alveolus is set to `auto` and there is a single alveolus in it, this will default to it instead of using classpath deployment.

name: bundlebee.apply.manifest
description: Manifest to load to start to deploy (a file path or inline). This optional setting mainly enables to use dependencies easily. Ignored if set to `skip`.

name: bundlebee.apply.from
description: Root dependency to download to get the manifest. If set to `auto` it is assumed to be present in current classpath.

name: bundlebee.apply.injectTimestamp
description: If `true`, a `bundlebee.timestamp` label will be injected into the descriptors with current date before applying the descriptor.

name: bundlebee.apply.injectBundleBeeMetadata
description: If `true`, `bundlebee.*` labels will be injected into the descriptors. This is required for rollback command to work.

name: bundlebee.apply.useChainInsteadOfAll
description: If `true`, each descriptor installation awaits previous ones instead of being concurrent. Enable an easier debugging for errors.

name: bundlebee.apply.skipGet
description: If `true`, the alveolus is installed without checking it already exists (assuming it doesn't) so some merge or sanitization logic is bypassed.

name: bundlebee.apply.trackState
description: If `true`, a secret named based on the alveolus name (`$name-bbs`) is stored and is used by the client to track the internal state of the installation. Note that it requires the client to have the permission to create a `Secret` even if the alveolus doesn't have any. Note that it doesn't work with `alveolus=auto` mode. The secret is stored in the globally configured namespace (default one if you do use a `kubeconfig` file).

name: bundlebee.apply.skipStaledResourceDeletion
description: If `true` and `trackState` is `true`, staled resources are not deleted but just logged.

name: bundlebee.apply.descriptorAwaitTimeout
description: For descriptors with `await` = `true` the max duration the test can last.

name: bundlebee.apply.excludedDescriptors
description: Enables to exclude descriptors from the command line. `none` to ignore. Value is comma separated. Note that using this setting, location is set to `*` so only the name is matched.

name: bundlebee.apply.excludedLocations
description: Enables to exclude locations (descriptor is set to `*`) from the command line. `none` to ignore. Value is comma separated.

name: bundlebee.build.dir
description: Project to build.

name: bundlebee.build.builddir
description: Project to build.

name: bundlebee.build.deployInLocalRepository
description: If `true` it will be added to your local maven repository.

name: bundlebee.build.group
description: Bundle groupId.

name: bundlebee.build.artifact
description: Bundle artifactId.

name: bundlebee.build.version
description: Bundle version.

name: bundlebee.cipher.masterPassword
description: Master password..

name: bundlebee.cipher.value
description: Value to cipher.

name: bundlebee.completion.useLogger
description: If true logger will be used instead of stdout.

name: comp.line
description: Matches bash COMP_LINE environment variable, represents the current command line.

name: comp.point
description: Matches bash COMP_POINT environment variable, represents the index of the cursor position.

name: bundlebee.decipher.masterPassword
description: Master password..

name: bundlebee.decipher.value
description: Value to decipher.

name: bundlebee.delete.alveolus
description: Alveolus name to rollback (in currently deployed version). When set to `auto`, it will look up all manifests found in the classpath (it is not recommended until you perfectly know what you do). If you set manifest option, alveolus is set to `auto` and there is a single alveolus in it, this will default to it instead of using classpath deployment.

name: bundlebee.delete.manifest
description: Manifest to load to start to find the alveolus. This optional setting mainly enables to use dependencies easily. Ignored if set to `skip`.

name: bundlebee.delete.from
description: Root dependency to download to get the manifest. If set to `auto` it is assumed to be present in current classpath.

name: bundlebee.delete.gracePeriodSeconds
description: If set it will be added on REST calls to force a custom grace period (in seconds). Setting it to `0` enables to delete faster objects.

name: bundlebee.delete.awaitTimeout
description: If an integer > 0, how long (ms) to await for the actual deletion of components, default does not await.

name: bundlebee.delete.descriptorAwaitTimeout
description: For descriptors with `await` = `true` the max duration the test can last. It is per descriptor with await true and independent of `awaitTimeout`.

name: bundlebee.apply.trackState
description: If `true` and a secret named based on the alveolus name (`$name-bbs`) exists, then it will be deleted.

name: bundlebee.delete.excludedDescriptors
description: Enables to exclude descriptors from the command line. `none` to ignore. Value is comma separated. Note that using this setting, location is set to `*` so only the name is matched.

name: bundlebee.delete.excludedLocations
description: Enables to exclude locations (descriptor is set to `*`) from the command line. `none` to ignore. Value is comma separated.

name: bundlebee.deploy.dir
description: Project to build.

name: bundlebee.deploy.builddir
description: Where to build (for build/temp files).

name: bundlebee.deploy.deployInLocalRepository
description: If `true` it will be added to your local maven repository too.

name: bundlebee.deploy.enableReUpload
description: If `true` it enables to upload an artifact even if already present. When `auto` it enables it for snapshots but not for releases.

name: bundlebee.deploy.nexusBaseApi
description: If not `skip` it will deploy the artifact on a remote repository (nexus v2 or v3). Syntax must be a URL pointing to the REST API (base URL). If you don't set the userinfo (username:password) in the URL it will be looked up in your settings.xml - potentially ciphered - using the hostname as serverId until you force it with `--serverId`.

name: bundlebee.deploy.nexusRepository
description: Nexus repository. It is the repository name the artifact(s) will be uploaded to. If `auto`, it will be `maven-releases` if the version is a release one and `maven-snapshots` otherwise.

name: bundlebee.deploy.serverId
description: ServerId to lookup from your maven settings.xml for remote deployment if enabled (nexus authentication).

name: bundlebee.deploy.group
description: Bundle groupId.

name: bundlebee.deploy.artifact
description: Bundle artifactId.

name: bundlebee.deploy.version
description: Bundle version.

name: bundlebee.diff.alveolus
description: Alveolus name to inspect. When set to `auto`, it will look for all manifests found in the classpath. If you set manifest option, alveolus is set to `auto` and there is a single alveolus in it, this will default to it instead of using classpath deployment.

name: bundlebee.diff.manifest
description: Manifest to load to start to find the alveolus. This optional setting mainly enables to use dependencies easily. Ignored if set to `skip`.

name: bundlebee.diff.from
description: Root dependency to download to get the manifest. If set to `auto` it is assumed to be present in current classpath.

name: bundlebee.diff.descriptor
description: If set only this descriptor is handled, not that you can use a regex if you make the value prefixed with `r/`. Note it generally only makes sense with verbose option.

name: bundlebee.diff.concurrency
description: Max concurrent requests to Kubernetes cluster. Value can't be less than `1`.

name: bundlebee.diff.ignoredPointers
description: A list (comma separated values) of JSON-Pointer to ignore in the comparison of client/configured state and actual cluster state. Note that these ones will also affect `ignoreEmptyJsonObjectRemovals` since they are dropped before testing the value.

name: bundlebee.diff.customIgnoredPointers
description: Same as `ignoredPointers` but enables to keep defaults.

name: bundlebee.diff.ignorableAttributes
description: A list (comma separated values) of attribute to ignore if in the Kubernetes model but not in local descriptor (it is mainly fields with defaults). Note that they behave as relative path (`endsWith`) so you should start them with a `/` in general.

name: bundlebee.diff.customIgnorableAttributes
description: Same as `ignorableAttributes` but enables to keep defaults.

name: bundlebee.diff.ignoreEmptyRemovals
description: Should a diff where the `op` is `remove` or `replace` and the associated `value` an empty JSON-Object/JSON-Array be ignored.

name: bundlebee.diff.formatted
description: Should JSON(-Diff) be formatted.

name: bundlebee.diff.showLocalSource
description: If `true`, the local location of the description will be added to the diff.

name: bundlebee.diff.ignoreNoDiffEntries
description: If `true`, the descriptors without any notable diff will be ignored from the report.

name: bundlebee.diff.maxDifferences
description: If there are at least this number of differences then the build will fail, disabled if negative.

name: bundlebee.diff.diffType
description: How to print the diff for each descriptor, `AUTO` means use `JSON-Patch` when there is a diff, `JSON` when a descriptor is missing and skip the content when it is the same. `JSON_PATCH` means always use `JSON-Patch` format. `JSON` means always show expected state.

name: bundlebee.diff.outputType
description: How to dump the diff, by default (`LOG`) it will print it but `FILE` will store it in a local file (using `dumpLocation`).

name: bundlebee.diff.dumpLocation
description: Diff location when `outputType` is `FILE`.

name: bundlebee.helm.alveolus
description: Alveolus name to deploy. When set to `auto`, it will deploy all manifests found in the classpath. If you set manifest option, alveolus is set to `auto` and there is a single alveolus in it, this will default to it instead of using classpath deployment.

name: bundlebee.helm.excludedLocations

name: bundlebee.helm.output
description: Where to create helm chart.

name: bundlebee.helm.chart.name
description: Helm chart name, if `auto` it will be the alveolus name if a single one is selected else it is `alveolus`.

name: bundlebee.helm.chart.description
description: Helm chart description.

name: bundlebee.helm.chart.version
description: Helm chart version.

name: bundlebee.helm.chart.appVersion
description: Helm chart app version.

name: bundlebee.helm.chart.dropSnapshot
description: Should `-SNAPSHOT` be removed from the version if present.

name: bundlebee.helm.placeholderDescriptions
description: An optional file path to a properties file where the keys are placeholders and the value some description to inject in `values.yaml`.

name: bundlebee.help.command
description: Which command to show help for. If not set it will show all commands.

name: bundlebee.help.args
description: If `false` args are not shown, enable a lighter output.

name: bundlebee.help.shared
description: If `false` shared configuration (by all commands) is not shown.

name: bundlebee.http.method
description: HTTP verb to use for the request.

name: bundlebee.http.payload
description: HTTP payload to use for the request - skipped for method different from `PATCH`, `POST` and `PUT`.

name: bundlebee.http.headers
description: Request HTTP headers (in properties format).

name: bundlebee.http.path
description: HTTP request path (optionally with query parameters). You can use the absolute kubernetes URL but if the value does not start with a protocol (`http` or `https`) then it will be prefixed by the Kubernetes API base.

name: bundlebee.http.payloadOnly
description: If `true`, only the payload of the response will be logged if successful.

name: bundlebee.http.failOnError
description: If `true`, an exception if thrown if the status is not between 200 and 299 (making the execution a failure).

name: bundlebee.inspect.alveolus
description: Alveolus name to inspect. When set to `auto`, it will look for all manifests found in the classpath. If you set manifest option, alveolus is set to `auto` and there is a single alveolus in it, this will default to it instead of using classpath deployment.

name: bundlebee.inspect.manifest
description: Manifest to load to start to find the alveolus. This optional setting mainly enables to use dependencies easily. Ignored if set to `skip`.

name: bundlebee.inspect.from
description: Root dependency to download to get the manifest. If set to `auto` it is assumed to be present in current classpath.

name: bundlebee.inspect.descriptor
description: If set only this descriptor is logged, not that you can use a regex if you make the value prefixed with `r/`. Note it generally only makes sense with verbose option.

name: bundlebee.inspect.verbose
description: If `true`, descriptors are logged too.

name: bundlebee.lint.alveolus
description: Alveolus name to inspect. When set to `auto`, it will look for all manifests found in the classpath. If you set manifest option, alveolus is set to `auto` and there is a single alveolus in it, this will default to it instead of using classpath deployment.

name: bundlebee.lint.manifest
description: Manifest to load to start to find the alveolus. This optional setting mainly enables to use dependencies easily. Ignored if set to `skip`.

name: bundlebee.lint.from
description: Root dependency to download to get the manifest. If set to `auto` it is assumed to be present in current classpath.

name: bundlebee.lint.failLevel
description: If `true`, an exception is throw if there is at least one error.

name: bundlebee.lint.ignoredAlveoli
description: Comma separated list of alveoli names to ignore.

name: bundlebee.lint.ignoredDescriptors
description: Comma separated list of descriptors to ignore.

name: bundlebee.lint.ignoredRules
description: Comma separated list of rules to ignore (simple class name for built-in ones and check name for the others).

name: bundlebee.lint.forcedRules
description: Comma separated list of rules to use (others being ignored). `all` means use all discovered rules and `none` skip them all (useful as a toggle/bypass mode).

name: bundlebee.lint.showRemediation
description: Should remediation be shown (it is verbose so skipped by default).

name: bundlebee.lint.output
description: If not `false`, the path of the output in link:https://github.com/microsoft/sarif-tutorials[SARIF] format (JSON).

name: bundlebee.list-alveoli.from
description: Root dependency to download to get the manifest. If set to `auto` it is assumed to be present in current classpath.

name: bundlebee.list-alveoli.manifest
description: Manifest to load to start to find the alveolus. This optional setting mainly enables to use dependencies easily. Ignored if set to `skip`.

name: bundlebee.list-alveoli.output
description: `logger` means the standard bundlebee logging output stream else it is considered as a file path. Note that if you end the filename with `.json` it will be formatted as json else just readable text.

name: bundlebee.create-master-password.password
description: Master password value, if `auto` it will be generated.

name: bundlebee.cipher-password.password
description: Password value to cipher (`auto` generates a random one).

name: bundlebee.new.group
description: Bundle groupId.

name: bundlebee.new.artifact
description: Bundle artifactId.

name: bundlebee.new.version
description: Bundle version.

name: bundlebee.new.dir
description: Where to create the project. If not set it will use the artifact value in current folder.

name: bundlebee.new.skipSamples
description: By default a sample alveolus with a config map is generated, if `false` it will be skipped.

name: bundlebee.new.skipPom
description: If `true` no pom.xml is generated.

name: bundlebee.new.force
description: If `true` the execution runs even if dir already exists.

name: bundlebee.placeholder-extract.alveolus
description: Alveolus name to inspect. When set to `auto`, it will look for all manifests found in the classpath. If you set manifest option, alveolus is set to `auto` and there is a single alveolus in it, this will default to it instead of using classpath deployment.

name: bundlebee.placeholder-extract.manifest
description: Manifest to load to start to find the alveolus. This optional setting mainly enables to use dependencies easily. Ignored if set to `skip`.

name: bundlebee.placeholder-extract.from
description: Root dependency to download to get the manifest. If set to `auto` it is assumed to be present in current classpath.

name: bundlebee.placeholder-extract.descriptor
description: If set only this descriptor is handled, not that you can use a regex if you make the value prefixed with `r/`. Note it generally only makes sense with verbose option.

name: bundlebee.placeholder-extract.outputType
description: How to dump the placeholders, by default (`LOG`) it will print it but `FILE` will store it in a local file (using `dumpLocation`).

name: bundlebee.placeholder-extract.dumpLocation
description: Extraction location (directory) when `outputType` is `FILE`.

name: bundlebee.placeholder-extract.propertiesFilename
description: Properties filename (relative to `dumpLocation`) when `outputType` is `FILE`. Ignores properties extraction if value is `skip`.

name: bundlebee.placeholder-extract.jsonFilename
description: JSON filename (relative to `dumpLocation`) when `outputType` is `FILE`. Ignores JSON dump if value is `skip`.

name: bundlebee.placeholder-extract.completionFilename
description: Completion properties filename - see https://github.com/rmannibucau/vscode-properties-custom-completion - (relative to `dumpLocation`) when `outputType` is `FILE`. Ignores this extraction if value is `skip`.

name: bundlebee.placeholder-extract.docFilename
description: Asciidoc filename (relative to `dumpLocation`) when `outputType` is `FILE`. Ignores this extraction if value is `skip`.

name: bundlebee.placeholder-extract.descriptions
description: Properties file locations which contain key=the placeholder and value=the placeholder description.

name: bundlebee.placeholder-extract.ignoredPlaceholders
description: List of placeholders or prefixes (ended with `.*`) to ignore. This is common for templates placeholders which don't need documentation since they are wired in the manifest in general.

name: bundlebee.placeholder-extract.failOnInvalidDescription
description: Should documentation generation fail on missing/unexpected placeholder description.

name: bundlebee.process.alveolus

name: bundlebee.process.manifest
description: Manifest to load to start to deploy (a file path or inline). This optional setting mainly enables to use dependencies easily. Ignored if set to `skip`.

name: bundlebee.process.from
description: Root dependency to download to get the manifest. If set to `auto` it is assumed to be present in current classpath.

name: bundlebee.process.injectTimestamp

name: bundlebee.process.injectBundleBeeMetadata

name: bundlebee.process.concat

name: bundlebee.rollback.previousAlveolus
description: Alveolus name to install as rollback.

name: bundlebee.rollback.previousManifest
description: Same as `manifest` but for the previous alveolus to install.

name: bundlebee.rollback.previousFrom
description: Same as `from` but for the previous alveolus to install.

name: bundlebee.rollback.alveolus
description: Alveolus name to rollback (in currently deployed version). When set to `auto`, it will look up all manifests found in the classpath (it is not recommended until you perfectly know what you do). If you set manifest option, alveolus is set to `auto` and there is a single alveolus in it, this will default to it instead of using classpath deployment.

name: bundlebee.rollback.manifest
description: Manifest to load to start to find the alveolus. This optional setting mainly enables to use dependencies easily. Ignored if set to `skip`.

name: bundlebee.rollback.from
description: Root dependency to download to get the manifest. If set to `auto` it is assumed to be present in current classpath.

name: bundlebee.rollback.gracePeriodSeconds
description: If set it will be added on REST calls to force a custom grace period (in seconds). Setting it to `0` enables to delete faster objects.

name: bundlebee.rollback.awaitTimeout
description: If an integer > 0, how long (ms) to await for the actual deletion of components - before redeploying.

name: bundlebee.rollback.pause
description: A pause (in ms) between delete and apply phases, this can some environment to release all resources related to deleted components.

name: bundlebee.rollback.useMavenVersioning
description: If `true`, and previous alveolus is not defined on the CLI, we will query the release repository to find available versions. If the alveolus name does not match `<groupId>:<artifactId>:<version>[:<type>:<classifier>]` pattern then a heuristic is used instead.

name: bundlebee.run.alveolus
description: Alveolus name to deploy. When set to `auto`, it will deploy all manifests found in the classpath. If you set manifest option, alveolus is set to `auto` and there is a single alveolus in it, this will default to it instead of using classpath deployment.

name: bundlebee.run.manifest
description: Manifest to load to start to deploy (a file path or inline). This optional setting mainly enables to use dependencies easily. Ignored if set to `skip`.

name: bundlebee.run.from
description: Root dependency to download to get the manifest. If set to `auto` it is assumed to be present in current classpath.

name: bundlebee.run.useChainInsteadOfAll
description: If `true`, each descriptor installation awaits previous ones instead of being concurrent. Enable an easier debugging for errors.

name: bundlebee.run.descriptorAwaitTimeout
description: For descriptors with `await` = `true` the max duration the test can last.

name: bundlebee.run.excludedDescriptors
description: Enables to exclude descriptors from the command line. `none` to ignore. Value is comma separated. Note that using this setting, location is set to `*` so only the name is matched.

name: bundlebee.run.excludedLocations
description: Enables to exclude locations (descriptor is set to `*`) from the command line. `none` to ignore. Value is comma separated.

name: bundlebee.versions.group
description: Bundle groupId.

name: bundlebee.versions.artifact
description: Bundle artifactId.

name: bundlebee.yaml2json.input
description: The directory path to read yaml files to convert.

name: bundlebee.yaml2json.output
description: The directory path to write the generated json files.

name: bundlebee.yaml2json.logDescriptorOnParsingError
description: Should YAML/JSON be logged when it can't be parsed.

name: bundlebee.httpclient.threads
description: How many threads are allocated to async HTTP client, negative or zero value means to use common pool.

name: bundlebee.httpclient.forcedHttpVersion
description: The HTTP client version, `none` mean the JVM default (v2), `HTTP_1_1` v1.1 and `HTTP_2` v2.0.

name: bundlebee.httpclient.connectTimeout
description: The HTTP client connect timeout (in java Duration format), `none` can be used to ignore this setting.

name: bundlebee.httpclient.followRedirects
description: The HTTP client redirect policy. Default to `NORMAL`, can be set to `ALWAYS` or `NEVER`.

name: kubeconfig
description: Kubeconfig location. If set to `auto` it will try to guess from your `$HOME/.kube/config` file until you set it so `explicit` where it will use other `bundlebee.kube` properties to create the client. The content can also be set inline!

name: bundlebee.kube.http.timeout
description: HTTP timeout in ms, ignored if <= 0.

name: bundlebee.kube.api
description: When kubeconfig is not set the base API endpoint.

name: bundlebee.kube.token
description: When `kubeconfig` is set to `explicit`, the bearer token to use (if set).

name: bundlebee.kube.context
description: When kubeconfig (explicit or not) is used, the context to use. If not set it is taken from the kubeconfig itself.

name: bundlebee.kube.proxy.host
description: If a proxy is needed to contact the target cluster API, its host, ignore if not set.

name: bundlebee.kube.proxy.port
description: If a proxy is needed to contact the target cluster API, its port.

name: bundlebee.kube.proxy.username
description: If a proxy is needed to contact the target cluster API, its username if it needs an authentication (take care the JVM can nee `-Djdk.http.auth.tunneling.disabledSchemes=` options).

name: bundlebee.kube.proxy.password
description: If a proxy is needed to contact the target cluster API, its password if it needs an authentication (take care the JVM can nee `-Djdk.http.auth.tunneling.disabledSchemes=` options).

name: bundlebee.kube.proxy.setProxySystemProperties
description: If a proxy is configured to use authentication, automatically set `-Djdk.http.auth.tunneling.disabledSchemes=`, note that setting it on the JVM is still more reliable depending how you run bundlebee (in particular with maven or embed). Important: the system property is "leaked", ie it is not cleaned up to limit side effect in concurrent mode.

name: bundlebee.kube.validateSSL
description: Should SSL connector be validated or not.

name: bundlebee.kube.namespace
description: When kubeconfig is not set the namespace to use.

name: bundlebee.kube.verbose
description: If `true` http requests/responses to Kubernetes will be logged.

name: bundlebee.kube.dryRun
description: If `true` http requests/responses are skipped. Note that dry run implies verbose=true for the http client. Note that as of today, all responses are mocked by a HTTP 200 and an empty JSON payload.

name: bundlebee.kube.skipDryRunForGet
description: If `true` GET http requests are not skipped when `dryRun` is true.

name: bundlebee.kube.rateLimiter.enabled
description: Should HTTP client requests be limited and HTTP 427 responses be handled.

name: bundlebee.kube.rateLimiter.permits
description: How many calls can be done if rate limiting is enabled. Note that setting it to `Integer.MAX_VALUE` will disable the client rate limiting and only enable server one.

name: bundlebee.kube.rateLimiter.window
description: Rate limiting window duration in milliseconds (default being 1 second).

name: bundlebee.kube.fieldValidation
description: `fieldValidation` - server side validation - value when applying a descriptor, values can be `Strict`, `Warn` pr `Ignore`. Note that using `skip` will ignore the query parameter.

name: bundlebee.kube.resourceMapping
description: Enables to define resource mapping, syntax uses propeties one: `<lowercased resource kind>s = /apis/....`.

name: bundlebee.kube.skipUpdateForKinds
description: List of _kind_ of descriptors updates can be skipped, it is often useful for `PersistentVolumeClaim`.

name: bundlebee.kube.logDescriptorOnParsingError
description: Should YAML/JSON be logged when it can't be parsed.

name: bundlebee.kube.filters.statefuleset.spec.allowed
description: The attributes to keep from `StatefulSet` (`spec` children) descriptor on updates.

name: bundlebee.kube.implicitlyDroppedAttributes
description: Enables to tolerate custom attributes in the descriptors. Typically used to drop `/$schema` attribute which enables a nice completion in editors. Values are `|` delimited and are either a JSON-Pointer (wrapped in a remove JSON-Patch) or directly a JSON-Patch. Using `none` ignores this processing.

name: bundlebee.kube.putOnUpdate
description: By default a descriptor update is done using `PATCH` with strategic merge patch logic, if set to `true` it will use a plain `PUT`. Note that `io.yupiik.bundlebee/putOnUpdate` annotations can be set to `true` to force that in the descriptor itself.

name: bundlebee.kube.force
description: By default a descriptor update is done using `PATCH` with strategic merge patch logic, if set to `true` it will use a plain `PUT`. Note that `io.yupiik.bundlebee/putOnUpdate` annotations can be set to `true` to force that in the descriptor itself and for cases it is not enough, you can set `force` to `true` to delete the descriptor before applying it again (move from clusterip to nodeport or the opposite in a serice for ex). Note that you can set it to `true` in a descriptor annotation `io.yupiik.bundlebee/force` too to not be global.

name: bundlebee.kube.defaultPropagationPolicy
description: Default value for deletions of `propagationPolicy`. Values can be `Orphan`, `Foreground` and `Background`.

name: bundlebee.kube.customMetadataInjectionPoint
description: When using custom metadata (bundlebee ones or timestamp to force a rollout), where to inject them. Default uses labels since it enables to query them later on but you can switch it to annotations.

name: bundlebee.kube.patchContentType
description: Default header value for `PATCH` `content-type` requests header. It uses strategic merge patch algorithm but in some cases you just want to use `application/json` or (better) `application/merge-patch+json`. Annotation `io.yupiik.bundlebee/patchContentType` is also supported.

name: bundlebee.awaiter.retryInterval
description: How often to retry for a descriptor condition. Increasing it will reduce the pressure on the Kubernetes REST API (rate limiting for example).

name: bundlebee.maven.http.connectTimeout
description: When fetching a dependency using HTTP, the connection timeout for this dependency.

name: bundlebee.maven.cache
description: Where to cache maven dependencies. If set to `auto`, tries to read the system property `maven.repo.local` then the `settings.xml` `localRepository` and finally it would fallback on `$HOME/.m2/repository`.

name: bundlebee.maven.preferCustomSettingsXml
description: If `false` we first try to read `settings.xml` file(s) in `cache` location before the default one.

name: bundlebee.maven.forceCustomSettingsXml
description: If `true` we only use `cache` value and never fallback on default maven settings.xml location.

name: bundlebee.maven.repositories.release
description: Default release repository.

name: bundlebee.maven.repositories.snapshot
description: Default snapshot repository, not set by default.

name: bundlebee.maven.repositories.httpHeaders
description: Properties to define the headers to set per repository, syntax is `host1=headerName headerValue` and it supports as much lines as used repositories. Note that you can use maven `~/.m2/settings.xml` servers (potentially ciphered) username/password pairs. In this last case the server id must be `bundlebee.<server host>`. Still in settings.xml case, if the username is null the password value is used as raw `Authorization` header else username/password is encoded as a basic header.

name: bundlebee.maven.repositories.downloads.enabled
description: Enable the download, i.e. ensure it runs only with local maven repository.
